tool_args.rationale: The three-coefficient saturation model fits all ten paid rows with training RMSE about 3.2e-8, including the gradient variation from 0.18 to 2.35. Submit it for fresh confirmation at tolerance 0.045. Its continuation above the measured gradient range is an untested extrapolation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The largest measured gradient is 2.35, below the proposed onset of 2.50–2.68. Neither the onset nor the penalty strength can be fitted from these rows.

considered_alternatives.option: Haldane inhibition and Cobb–Douglas power law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Haldane alone cannot represent the measured gradient effect. Cobb–Douglas lacks the observed saturation structure, which the selected model fits to rounding precision.

considered_alternatives.option: Repeat the open-branch probe or extra fine trajectory batch
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Both batches have already been acquired and neither sampled the proposed onset region. No dedicated high-gradient probe is listed.
